-module(beam_fixture_add).
-export([run/0,add/2]).
run() -> add(17,25).
add(A,B) when is_integer(A), is_integer(B) -> A+B.

-module(beam_fixture_receive).
-export([run/0]).
run() -> self() ! ping, receive ping -> {ok,ping} after 1000 -> timeout end.

-module(beam_fixture_closure).
-export([run/0,make/1]).
run() -> F=make(5), {ok,F(7),is_function(F,1)}.
make(N) -> fun(X) -> N+X end.

ObserverDeclarations.Name: fresh-success
ObserverDeclarations.NewSource:
-module(beam_on_load_fresh_success).
-on_load(init/0).
-export([run/0]).
init() ->
    Observer = whereis(beam_on_load_observer),
    true = is_pid(Observer),
    Observer ! {on_load_notice,?MODULE,self(),code:is_loaded(?MODULE),success},
    receive
        {on_load_continue,Observer} -> ok
    after 10000 ->
        error(observer_timeout)
    end.
run() -> new_image.
